mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'PAID'

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS timeLabel,
DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS timeLabel,
CONCAT(YEAR(created_at), '-Q', QUARTER(created_at)) AS timeLabel,
DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y') AS timeLabel,
DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS timeLabel,
DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS timeLabel,
SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY timeLabel ORDER BY timeLabel ASC

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.payment_status = 'PAID' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.payment_status = 'PAID' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unitsSold FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalUnitsSold, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS totalRevenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY totalUnitsSold DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id AS productId, name AS productName, quantity AS stockQuantity FROM products WHERE quantity < #{threshold} ORDER BY quantity ASC
